pool.name: DLL Enterprise Scale Pool
pool.description: Decision Loop Labs test pool for scale and heterogeneity: 16 fictitious organizations across industry, enterprise software, automotive, cybersecurity, financial technology, healthcare technology, cloud infrastructure and data & AI, with 48 distinct roles.

organizations.name: Rheinmark Industrieanlagen AG
organizations.description: Builds and automates steel processing and rolling lines worldwide; supplies PLC, SCADA and MES software with each plant and services more than 300 installed lines.

organizations.name: Nordisk Pumps & Fluid Systems A/S
organizations.description: Manufactures pumps and dosing systems for water utilities and buildings; connects them to a cloud service for monitoring, predictive maintenance and energy optimisation.

organizations.name: Quillstone Software Ltd
organizations.description: Sells a cloud ERP suite to mid-market manufacturers and distributors: finance, inventory, procurement and planning modules on a shared multi-tenant platform.

organizations.name: Tessaro Workflow GmbH
organizations.description: Offers a low-code workflow platform with its own process language; public administrations and insurers model, run and audit business processes with it.

organizations.name: Valcor Automotive Electronics GmbH
organizations.description: Develops body and chassis control units and zonal controllers for European OEMs; software developed under ASPICE level 3 and ISO 26262 processes.

organizations.name: Corvane Mobility s.r.o.
organizations.description: Builds battery packs for light commercial EVs and runs a charging network for fleet depots, including the backend that schedules depot charging against grid tariffs.

organizations.name: Sentinel Ridge Security Oy
organizations.description: Provides 24/7 managed detection and response for Nordic enterprises and municipalities, running its own SOC, detection content and incident response team.

organizations.name: Ironquay Cryptography Ltd
organizations.description: Makes hardware security modules and a managed PKI service for IoT manufacturers, currently adding post-quantum algorithms to its product line.

organizations.name: Ledgerline Bank SE
organizations.description: Digital bank with an EU banking licence serving SMEs in the Baltics and DACH: accounts, cards, lending and FX, built on an in-house core banking platform.

organizations.name: Paxford Capital Technologies Ltd
organizations.description: Builds electronic trading and risk systems for its own market-making desks and for institutional clients, across equities, FX and rates.

organizations.name: Medivane Digital Health GmbH
organizations.description: Develops prescribable digital therapy apps (DiGA) for chronic pain and sleep disorders, with clinical studies, a medical quality system and integrations to German health insurers.

organizations.name: Carelink Imaging B.V.
organizations.description: Supplies imaging workflow and post-processing software to radiology departments: PACS integration, 3D reconstruction and AI-assisted reading tools.

organizations.name: Stratoforge Cloud SAS
organizations.description: Operates a SecNumCloud-qualified public cloud in four French data centres: compute, block and object storage, managed Kubernetes and network services.

organizations.name: Arcvale Edge Networks AB
organizations.description: Runs a content delivery and edge compute network with 90 points of presence, serving media streaming and e-commerce customers.

organizations.name: Datalume Consulting SpA
organizations.description: Data and AI consultancy delivering analytics platforms, BI and AI products for retailers, banks and manufacturers in Southern Europe.

organizations.name: Synaptiq Speech Technologies S.L.
organizations.description: Builds speech recognition and voice assistants for contact centres in Spanish, Catalan, Portuguese and English, deployable on customer premises.

roles.title: Automation Software Engineer – PLC & SCADA
roles.description: You program and commission the control software of rolling-line sections: IEC 61131-3 PLC programs on Siemens S7-1500, HMI screens in WinCC, and SCADA integration. Work splits between engineering in Duisburg and commissioning trips to customer plants, where you test with real equipment, tune sequences with process engineers and train operators. You reuse and improve the company's standard function blocks. You join a team of twelve automation engineers organised by line section; a senior engineer reviews your first projects. Success after a year means commissioning a section largely on your own and contributing a reusable block to the standard library.

roles.title: Industrial Data Engineer – Historian & MES
roles.description: Rolling lines produce millions of sensor values per hour. You connect plant historians and the MES to Rheinmark's analytics platform: OPC UA and historian interfaces, a time-series data model that keeps the relation between coil, pass and measurement, and pipelines into the cloud lake for quality analytics. You work with process engineers who need answers ('why did thickness deviate on coil 4711?') and with IT security on OT/IT boundaries. You sit in the digital services unit (data engineers, a data scientist, two process experts) and own the data model that every quality analysis builds on. We expect solid data engineering experience; manufacturing exposure can be learned on the job.

roles.title: OT Security Architect
roles.description: Customers now require secure-by-design automation. You define the security architecture for Rheinmark's delivered plants: zone and conduit models per IEC 62443, secure remote service access, hardening baselines for engineering stations, patch strategies that respect production windows, and the security documentation handed over to customers. You review project designs, support bids and answer customers' security questionnaires. You report to the head of engineering, work with four project security leads and are the escalation point for customer security audits. Several years of OT or ICS security work and the ability to explain controls to plant managers are essential.

roles.title: Embedded Software Engineer – Pump Controllers
roles.description: You develop firmware for the controllers that run Nordisk's variable-speed pumps: motor control loops on ARM Cortex-M, the Modbus and BACnet interfaces building systems use, and the secure bootloader that receives updates from the cloud service. You test on hardware-in-the-loop rigs, measure energy consumption, and work with hydraulic engineers on control behaviour. The controller team has nine engineers across firmware, electronics and test; you pair on reviews and own one interface stack end to end. Two or more years of shipped embedded C are expected, motor control knowledge helps.

roles.title: IoT Solutions Architect – Connected Pumps
roles.description: Two million pumps could report data; today 80,000 do. You design how the fleet connects at scale: device identity and provisioning, MQTT connectivity through gateways in buildings and utilities, over-the-air update strategy, and the cloud architecture on Azure IoT that serves monitoring and predictive maintenance. You align product management, firmware teams and cloud teams on one roadmap and cost model. You report to the CTO of the digital business, lead an architecture guild of five engineers and own the cost model of connectivity. Expect to spend real time with utilities' IT departments on security and integration questions.

roles.title: Product Owner – Connected Services
roles.description: You own the backlog of Nordisk's monitoring app used by facility managers and utility operators. You interview customers, turn service technicians' pain into features (alarm handling, energy reports, remote setpoints), prioritise with a cross-functional team of eight, and measure adoption. You balance hardware realities and release cycles with a cloud product that ships every two weeks. Your team: five engineers, a UX designer and a QA engineer, plus field service colleagues who test early versions with customers. You present the roadmap quarterly to the business unit and are measured on adoption and support tickets avoided.

roles.title: Staff Engineer – Multi-Tenant Data Layer
roles.description: Quillstone's 9,000 tenants share sharded PostgreSQL clusters. You lead the evolution of this data layer: tenant placement and rebalancing, online schema migrations across thousands of databases, row-level security, and the performance work that keeps month-end closing fast. You set technical direction for three teams, write the design documents, and personally take on the hardest migrations. You work with the database reliability, platform and finance-module teams and report to the VP Engineering. We expect a long track record with relational databases at scale and the habit of writing down decisions others can review.

roles.title: Product Manager – Finance Modules
roles.description: You own general ledger, accounts payable and the period-close experience in Quillstone ERP. You work with accountants at customer sites, translate IFRS and local GAAP requirements into product capabilities, prioritise e-invoicing mandates country by country, and coordinate with two engineering teams. You need to understand accounting deeply enough to argue with a CFO. You partner with an engineering manager, a designer and two customer advisory boards in Ireland and Germany. Success is measured by close-cycle time at customers and by on-time delivery of statutory e-invoicing changes.

roles.title: Technical Writer – Developer Documentation
roles.description: Partners extend Quillstone ERP through 900 REST endpoints and webhooks. You own the developer documentation: API reference generated from OpenAPI, tutorials for common integrations, changelogs, and the docs-as-code pipeline. You test every example yourself, interview engineers, and measure which pages reduce support tickets. You are part of a three-person developer experience team with a developer advocate and an API platform engineer. We expect a portfolio of published developer documentation and comfort running code examples yourself.

roles.title: Compiler Engineer – Workflow Language
roles.description: Tessaro's process language compiles visual workflows into an executable intermediate representation. You work on the compiler: parser and type checker for expressions, static analysis that warns modellers about dead paths and unhandled errors, versioned migrations of running processes, and a language server that powers the editor. TypeScript front end, Kotlin back end. The language team has four engineers and works closely with the editor and runtime teams. A compiler, interpreter or static-analysis project you can talk about in depth matters more than a specific language background.

roles.title: Solutions Engineer – Public Sector
roles.description: You show public administrations how Tessaro digitises their procedures: discovery workshops, live modelling of a building-permit process in the room, proof-of-concept integrations with registers and e-ID services, and answers to security and accessibility requirements in tenders. You are the technical voice in the sales team and feed what you learn back to product. You work with three account executives and a public-sector consultant, and you travel within Austria and Germany about two days a week. We expect several years of pre-sales or consulting with technical depth.

roles.title: QA Automation Engineer
roles.description: Every Tessaro release must keep thousands of customer processes running. You build the automated regression safety net: end-to-end tests of the modelling editor with Playwright, API contract tests, a library of reference processes executed against each build, and flaky-test triage. You work embedded with two feature teams and own test strategy reviews for new features. You belong to the quality guild (five engineers) but sit with two feature teams day to day. Success means a stable nightly regression suite, fewer escaped defects and test strategy reviews that teams ask for rather than avoid.

roles.title: AUTOSAR Software Engineer – Zonal Controller
roles.description: You develop application and basic software for Valcor's zonal controller: AUTOSAR Classic SWCs, RTE configuration, CAN FD and automotive Ethernet communication, and integration with OEM toolchains. You implement against OEM requirements in DOORS, write unit and integration tests, and support vehicle testing. MISRA C compliance and ASPICE work products are part of daily work. The zonal controller project has about forty software engineers; you join the communication cluster with six colleagues and a technical lead. Two or more years of automotive embedded development are expected; AUTOSAR configuration can be deepened on the job.

roles.title: Functional Safety Engineer – ISO 26262
roles.description: For a brake-by-wire actuator controller you own the functional safety work products: hazard analysis and risk assessment with the OEM, safety goals and ASIL decomposition, technical safety concept, FMEDA with hardware, and the safety case. You review software and hardware designs for safety mechanisms and represent Valcor in confirmation reviews. You work in a safety team of five that supports several projects and you are the safety manager's counterpart for this controller. Expect frequent alignment with OEM safety managers and assessors.

roles.title: Vehicle Diagnostics Engineer – UDS & OTA
roles.description: You make Valcor's control units diagnosable and updatable over the air: UDS services and diagnostic trouble codes, ODX descriptions for OEM testers, flash bootloader behaviour, and the ECU side of OEM OTA campaigns including secure update verification. You debug field issues from workshop logs and support end-of-line test integration. You join the diagnostics and flashing team (seven engineers) that supports all controller projects. You will travel occasionally to OEM test sites and to the end-of-line test station in our Hungarian plant.

roles.title: Battery Management Systems Engineer
roles.description: You develop the algorithms of Corvane's battery management system: state-of-charge and state-of-health estimation with Kalman filters, cell balancing, thermal management strategies, and protection logic. You validate on cell cyclers and climate chambers, model cells in MATLAB/Simulink and generate production code, working closely with hardware and safety engineers. The battery systems team has eleven engineers across hardware, firmware, algorithms and test; you lead the estimation algorithms. We expect several years in BMS or comparable control-algorithm work and hands-on lab practice.

roles.title: Charging Backend Engineer – OCPP
roles.description: Corvane's charge-point management system talks to 6,000 chargers in fleet depots. You build its backend: OCPP 1.6 and 2.0.1 message handling, smart-charging profiles that keep depots under their grid limit, tariff and session data for billing, and robust handling of chargers that go offline mid-session. Python services on Kubernetes with PostgreSQL and Redis. You join a backend team of six engineers and an SRE; you share on-call for the charging network one week in five. Prior e-mobility experience is welcome but strong backend fundamentals matter more.

roles.title: Data Analyst – Fleet Telematics
roles.description: Fleet customers want to know which vans can go electric and how their batteries age. You analyse telematics and charging data: duty-cycle analyses, battery degradation trends, depot utilisation reports and dashboards for customer success. You write SQL and Python, present findings to customers, and help define the metrics the product team builds into the app. You work in the customer analytics team with two analysts and a data engineer and present results to fleet managers. This is an entry-level role: we expect solid SQL and curiosity, and offer mentoring by a senior analyst.

roles.title: SOC Analyst – Tier 2
roles.description: You investigate the alerts that Tier 1 escalates: endpoint detections, identity anomalies and cloud audit events across 140 customer environments. You correlate data in Microsoft Sentinel and the EDR console, decide whether an alert is an incident, contain hosts when needed, and write clear customer notifications. Shift work in a 24/7 rotation with a follow-the-sun handover. You are one of fourteen Tier 2 analysts working with Tier 1, detection engineering and incident response. Typically two or more years in a SOC or security operations role; we train on our tooling and customer environments.

roles.title: Detection Engineer
roles.description: You write the detections the SOC runs: behaviour-based analytics mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, detection-as-code with tests and CI, tuning based on false-positive feedback, and coverage reporting per customer. You emulate attacks in a lab to validate detections and share content with the threat intelligence team. You join a detection team of five that works with threat intelligence and the SOC shift leads. Success is measured by coverage, precision of alerts and how quickly new threats get a tested detection.

roles.title: Incident Responder – DFIR
roles.description: When a customer is breached you lead the technical response: scoping, forensic acquisition of disks, memory and cloud logs, timeline analysis, eradication planning with the customer's IT, and the final report that may be read by insurers and authorities. Ransomware cases are common; calm under pressure and precise documentation are essential. You are part of a seven-person incident response team that also handles retainer customers; on-call is one week in four. We expect several years of hands-on investigations, including ransomware cases.

roles.title: Cryptography Engineer – Post-Quantum
roles.description: Ironquay is adding ML-KEM and ML-DSA to its HSM firmware and PKI. You implement and integrate these algorithms: constant-time implementations, hybrid key exchange and certificate formats, side-channel testing with the hardware team, and the interoperability tests with customers' stacks. You follow standardisation closely and contribute to it where you can. You work with two cryptographers, the firmware team and the PKI product team, and represent Ironquay in standardisation discussions. A strong record of careful, reviewed cryptographic code is essential.

roles.title: PKI Operations Engineer
roles.description: You run Ironquay's managed PKI that issues identities to 40 million IoT devices: certificate authority hierarchies in HSMs, key ceremonies, issuance and revocation services, monitoring of OCSP and CRL endpoints, and the audit evidence for WebTrust-style assessments. Strict change control and dual control are part of every operation. You join a four-person PKI operations team with a strict dual-control model and quarterly key ceremonies. Experience operating security-critical infrastructure with formal change control is expected.

roles.title: Firmware Security Engineer – HSM
roles.description: You harden the firmware of Ironquay's HSM: secure boot chain, tamper response, memory protection, and the update mechanism. You perform security reviews and fuzzing of the command interface, prepare the evidence for FIPS 140-3 and Common Criteria evaluations, and fix what labs and your own testing find. You work with three firmware engineers and the hardware security lead and coordinate with external evaluation labs. Years of secure embedded development and the ability to document security arguments are expected.

roles.title: Core Banking Engineer – Accounts & Payments
roles.description: You build Ledgerline's core banking services: account lifecycle, interest and fee calculation, SEPA Instant and SWIFT payment processing, and end-of-day accounting. Java and Kotlin services on PostgreSQL with event sourcing for balances. You work with operations and finance on edge cases that only appear at month end, and every change passes four-eyes review and regulatory traceability. You join the accounts and payments squad (seven engineers, a product owner and a banking operations expert). We expect several years of backend development, ideally in banking or payments, and care for correctness.

roles.title: AML Data Scientist – Transaction Monitoring
roles.description: You improve how Ledgerline detects money laundering: scenario tuning for the rule engine, machine-learning models that prioritise alerts, network analysis of counterparties, and below-the-line testing that regulators expect. You work with compliance investigators to understand true positives and document every model for the model risk and AML functions. You work in the financial crime analytics team with two data scientists and a data engineer, embedded with compliance investigators. Explaining model behaviour to compliance officers and auditors is part of the job.

roles.title: Regulatory Reporting Analyst
roles.description: You produce and automate Ledgerline's supervisory reports: COREP and FINREP templates, liquidity reports (LCR, NSFR) and AnaCredit submissions. You trace each figure back to source data, build reconciliations between the ledger and reports, and work with data engineers to replace manual spreadsheets with tested pipelines. Close contact with finance and the regulator's questions are part of the job. You are one of three analysts in the regulatory reporting team within finance, working with data engineering and risk. Prior experience in bank reporting and comfort with data tooling are expected.

roles.title: Low-Latency C++ Engineer – Market Making
roles.description: You work on the market-making engine where microseconds matter: order book handling, quoting logic, exchange gateways and the hot path between them. You profile with hardware counters, reason about cache behaviour and lock-free structures, and work daily with quantitative traders on strategy behaviour. Production support during market hours is shared in the team. You join a team of eight engineers sitting with the trading desk. We expect several years of performance-critical C++ in trading or comparable latency-sensitive systems.

roles.title: Quantitative Developer – Risk
roles.description: You build the risk analytics the desks and risk managers rely on: pricing library integration, scenario and VaR engines, sensitivities (Greeks) across portfolios, and the intraday risk service that limits trading. Python and C++, with a strong focus on numerical correctness and reconciliation against independent models. You work in the risk technology team (six developers and two quants) and with risk managers and traders. A quantitative background and production-quality coding are both expected.

roles.title: Market Data Engineer
roles.description: You run the market data plant: feed handlers for exchanges and vendors, normalisation into an internal format, tick storage for research, and the monitoring that catches stale or crossed prices before traders do. You coordinate exchange changes and vendor releases and keep entitlements correct. You are part of a four-person market data team with a weekly support rota during market hours. Experience with financial data feeds is welcome; strong systems and data skills matter most.

roles.title: iOS Engineer – Prescribable Therapy App
roles.description: You build Medivane's iOS app that patients use daily for therapy sessions: SwiftUI interfaces with accessibility for older users, offline-first session data, HealthKit integration, and secure sync with the backend. The app is a medical device: you write requirements traceability, unit and UI tests, and work with the quality team on release documentation. You join a mobile team of five (two iOS, two Android, a QA engineer) working with clinicians and the quality manager. Several years of shipped iOS development are expected.

roles.title: Clinical Data Manager – Digital Therapy Studies
roles.description: Medivane's apps must prove benefit in randomised studies. You manage study data end to end: eCRF design, data management plans, data validation and query handling, integration of app-generated data with study databases, and database lock. You work with biostatisticians, CROs and the medical team under GCP. You work with two biostatisticians, the medical lead and external CROs on two to three studies in parallel. Prior clinical data management experience in studies through database lock is expected.

roles.title: Backend Engineer – Insurer Integration
roles.description: Patients activate therapy with a prescription code from their insurer. You build the services behind this: code validation with insurers' systems, billing data exchange, FHIR-based interfaces to the national e-prescription infrastructure, and the strict data minimisation required under GDPR and German social law. TypeScript on Node.js with PostgreSQL. You join the platform team of six engineers and work with the data protection officer on every interface. Experience with external integrations and privacy-sensitive data is expected; health-system knowledge can be learned.

roles.title: DICOM Integration Engineer
roles.description: You connect Carelink's post-processing software to hospitals' PACS and modalities: DICOM networking (C-STORE, C-FIND, DICOMweb), worklists, structured reports and HL7 orders. You troubleshoot integrations at customer sites with their IT, write conformance statements, and improve the integration test lab. You work in the integration team (eight engineers) and with customer project managers; site visits take about one week a month. Experience in healthcare IT integration is expected.

roles.title: Image Processing Scientist – 3D Reconstruction
roles.description: You develop algorithms for Carelink's 3D reading tools: segmentation of organs and vessels in CT and MR, registration of prior studies, and quantitative measurements radiologists rely on. You combine classical methods with deep learning, validate against expert annotations and bring algorithms into C++ production code with the engineering team. You work in a research group of seven scientists alongside the reading-tools engineering team and clinical partners. A research background in medical imaging and the ability to ship algorithms into products are expected.

roles.title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist – Software as a Medical Device
roles.description: You bring Carelink's AI-assisted reading tools to market: classification under MDR and FDA rules, technical documentation and design dossier, submissions (CE, 510(k)), and the regulatory strategy for algorithm updates. You work with R&D, clinical and quality, and you represent the company in notified-body audits. You are one of four RA specialists and the lead for the AI-assisted reading portfolio, working with R&D, clinical affairs and quality. Several years of medical device RA with software products are expected.

roles.title: Storage Systems Engineer – Ceph
roles.description: Stratoforge's block and object storage runs on Ceph across 40 petabytes. You design and operate it: cluster architecture and failure domains, capacity and performance planning, upgrades without customer impact, and automation of disk replacement. You debug latency spikes down to OSDs and networks and contribute fixes upstream when possible. You join a storage team of six engineers with a shared on-call rotation. Several years of operating distributed storage at scale are expected.

roles.title: Network Engineer – Data Center Fabric
roles.description: You run the EVPN-VXLAN fabrics that connect Stratoforge's data centres and tenant networks: design of spine-leaf topologies, BGP policies, network automation with NetBox and Ansible, and DDoS protection with upstream providers. Changes are automated and tested in a lab first. You work in a network team of nine engineers covering four data centres, with a change-advisory process for production. We expect several years of data centre networking with automation experience.

roles.title: Linux Kernel Engineer – Virtualization
roles.description: You work on the hypervisor layer under Stratoforge's compute service: KVM and QEMU tuning, live migration reliability, confidential computing with AMD SEV-SNP, and kernel bugs that only appear at fleet scale. You maintain internal patches, upstream them where possible and support incident investigations with crash dumps and tracing. You join the virtualisation team of five engineers and work with the compute product and security teams. A record of kernel or hypervisor work, ideally upstream, is expected.

roles.title: Edge Compute Engineer – WebAssembly Runtime
roles.description: Customers run code at Arcvale's edge: personalisation, A/B routing and image transformations. You build the multi-tenant WebAssembly runtime that makes this safe and fast: isolation, cold-start optimisation, resource metering, and the developer SDK. Rust on Linux, deployed to 90 points of presence. You work in the edge compute team of six engineers with developer relations and the platform SRE team. Strong systems programming and an interest in language runtimes are expected.

roles.title: Systems Engineer – Rust Edge Proxy
roles.description: Every request to Arcvale passes through its edge proxy. You develop it: TLS termination, HTTP/3 and QUIC support, cache logic, and the configuration pipeline that pushes customer rules worldwide in seconds. You also take part in the network on-call and investigate traffic anomalies. You join the proxy team of seven engineers; on-call for the global network is one week in six. Experience with network services in a systems language is expected; Rust can be deepened on the job.

roles.title: Capacity Planning Engineer
roles.description: Streaming peaks during sports finals can triple traffic within minutes. You forecast capacity per point of presence and transit link, model failure scenarios, decide when to add servers or peering, and turn traffic data into procurement plans finance can approve. Python, SQL and a lot of conversations with network and sales teams. You sit in the infrastructure planning team with two network planners and a finance partner. Experience with forecasting and infrastructure is expected; streaming-media knowledge is a plus.

roles.title: Analytics Engineer – dbt
roles.description: For retail and banking clients you build the modelled data layer between raw sources and dashboards: dbt projects on Snowflake or BigQuery, tested models, documentation and metrics definitions that business teams trust. You work on-site and remotely with client analysts, run workshops on metric definitions and hand over maintainable projects. You work in client teams of three to six consultants led by a delivery manager, about two days a week at client sites in Milan. Two or more years of analytics or data engineering are expected.

roles.title: BI Developer – Power BI
roles.description: You build reports and dashboards for Datalume's clients in Power BI: data models with DAX measures, row-level security, performance tuning of large datasets, and report design that executives can read in a minute. You learn from senior consultants and gradually take ownership of client workstreams. You join the BI practice of fifteen consultants with a senior mentor; first projects are in retail reporting. This is an entry-level role: we expect SQL basics, some Power BI and a sense for clear visual design.

roles.title: AI Product Manager – Client Solutions
roles.description: You shape AI products Datalume builds for clients — demand forecasting for retailers, document automation for banks — from discovery to adoption: framing the decision a model supports, defining success metrics and acceptable error, planning data acquisition, and steering a team of data scientists and engineers. You also make sure clients understand limits and governance obligations of what they buy. You lead client engagements with a delivery team of four to eight data scientists and engineers and report to the AI practice lead. Several years of product management with ML products are expected.

roles.title: Speech Recognition Engineer
roles.description: You train and improve Synaptiq's ASR models for contact-centre audio: conformer and transducer architectures, domain adaptation to telephony noise and code-switching between Spanish and Catalan, streaming inference, and word error rate analysis per accent and channel. You own models from data preparation to on-premise deployment. You join the speech team of six researchers and engineers and work with customer deployment engineers. Several years of hands-on ASR or speech model training are expected.

roles.title: Conversational AI Designer
roles.description: You design how Synaptiq's voice assistants talk to callers of banks and utilities: dialogue flows, prompts and fallbacks, escalation to human agents, and the LLM instructions behind open-ended turns. You test with real call recordings, analyse where callers get stuck and iterate with engineers and the client's service teams. You work in a design team of three with the dialogue engineers and client service managers. A portfolio of live voice or chat dialogues is expected.

roles.title: Data Annotation Lead – Speech Corpora
roles.description: You run the team and tooling that produce Synaptiq's training data: transcription guidelines for four languages, a pool of freelance annotators, quality control with double annotation and audits, and the privacy process for recordings that contain personal data. You report corpus quality and throughput and work with the ASR team on what data to collect next. You lead three coordinators and a pool of about sixty freelance annotators and work with the ASR team and the DPO. Experience running annotation or comparable data operations is expected.
